evidence.ACL: Interstitial intermediate signal in ACL on T2WI, R/O grade 1 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of knee and tiny spur and subchondral cyst, more severe at medial compartment.
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of knee and tiny spur and subchondral cyst, more severe at medial compartment.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
evidence.Fracture: No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction noted
